answer: That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Because the saffron domain is checked at the raven verifier, the hollow audit publishes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature costs the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 2 epochs later. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
